newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: UBS upgrades Rieter to buy from hold.
newsitem.headline: UBS upgrades Rieter to buy from hold.

text.p: UBS said it had revised upwards its earning estimates for Rieter Holding and changed its recommendation for the textile machinery and automotive systems company's shares to buy from hold.

"Key figures published for 1996 surpassed our expectations and those of the market by around 10 percent," analysts Ivo Hanusch and Sandra Holderegger said in a research report, noting the company was also offering to buy back registered shares.
"Based on our increased earnings estimates, the discount to the market is now more than 30 percent," they said putting the price target at 550 Swiss francs. Rieter was unchanged at 438.
